features.title: A skill for Claude Code and Codex
features.what: It runs where the agent runs, as a skill folder.
features.evidence_quote: unslop is a skill for Claude Code and Codex that turns vibecoded, AI-looking UI into a designed interface with its own character.

features.title: It finds the slop first
features.what: Purple gradients, glows, emoji labels, shouty copy and uneven spacing, named.
features.evidence_quote: It finds the slop first, the purple gradients, glows, emoji labels, shouty copy and uneven spacing

features.title: Audit, with where it lives
features.what: Every sign of slop is listed with its location.
features.evidence_quote: **Audit.** Lists every sign of slop with where it lives.

features.title: A direction from the product
features.what: Character, the moments that carry the colour, and a signature detail.
features.evidence_quote: **Direction.** Character, world, the one or two moments that carry the color, and a signature detail, all taken from your product.

features.title: Nine passes, in order
features.what: Spacing, color, icons, copy, type, layout, details, visuals and motion.
features.evidence_quote: **Passes.** Spacing, color, icons, copy, type, layout, details, visuals and motion, in that order.

features.title: Works in the viewer's stack
features.what: Any framework the screen is built with, and a live site from a link.
features.evidence_quote: It works in whatever your screen is built with, like Next.js, React, Vue, Svelte, Tailwind or plain HTML and CSS

features.title: It says so when the screen is already good
features.what: It suggests small refinements instead of a redesign.
features.evidence_quote: If the screen is already good, it tells you so and suggests a few small refinements instead of redesigning it.

features.title: It asks before a paid generation
features.what: The prompt is shown and the paid call waits for a yes.
features.evidence_quote: it shows the prompt and asks before every paid generation

features.title: The exact thing you type
features.what: A slash command with your screen, your page or a live link.
features.evidence_quote: In Claude Code, type `/unslop` with what you want.

features.title: Story video needs two more tools
features.what: Playwright and ffmpeg, for the square story video.
features.evidence_quote: Story videos also require ffmpeg installed and available on your PATH.

risks.text: It is an agent skill: it needs Claude Code or Codex to run.
A paid hero image is optional, and it asks before every generation.
